subject: Web Development
title: Deno and Bun: Node's Challengers
description: A quick, practical guide to Deno and Bun: Node's Challengers.

hook.text: In 2018, Node.js creator Ryan Dahl said he had regrets. So he built Deno to fix them.

buildup.text: Deno added TypeScript support, secure permissions, and modern module loading from the start.

discovery.text: Then Bun arrived in 2023, promising to be dramatically faster than both Node and Deno.

twist.text: Despite the buzz, Node.js still dominates. Ecosystem inertia is incredibly hard to overcome.

climax.text: Competition is pushing Node to improve, adding features it ignored for years.
